description: ArchivEye lets authenticated users discover their active knowledge base collections, search indexed documents with semantic or full-text retrieval, inspect document metadata, query structured tabular datasets with read-only SQL, and load full document text when search previews are not enough. Semantic search generates query embeddings through ArchivEye's self-hosted embedding service before retrieving matching chunks from the user's private collections.
